item.title: Testing the new generation of AI-enabled fire-extinguishing drones
item.description: Drone makers are testing new, big drones that can deliver water or fire retardant with AI assistance. Aspen, Colorado is the first place trying them out. Cool and expensive? Yes. Effective? TBD.
item.content:encoded:

item.title: U.S. boycotts U.N. human rights review for second year running
item.description: The U.S. has skipped a key U.N. human rights review for the second year running. Rights groups warn the absence risks undermining global accountability.

item.title: Americans across the economic spectrum feel a 'panic' about finances, author says
item.description: Mona Chalabi spent five years following Americans living paycheck to paycheck, as well as those earning top wages. Her new book, Ten Lives, explores why financial security can feel so elusive.
item.content:encoded:

item.title: Gas prices dip below $4 but inflation remains stubbornly high
item.description: Gasoline prices fell below $4 a gallon Tuesday for the first time in three months — but the overall cost of living remains stubbornly high.

item.title: Seven days of chaos in the ER: How this country's healthcare system is unraveling
item.description: Renewed fighting has pushed Ethiopia's healthcare system close to collapse: "The whole emergency (room) was flooded with war trauma patients," one surgeon says of a brutal week in September.

item.title: House set to vote to impeach Hegseth. And, SCOTUS allows border wall work to proceed
item.description: The House could vote to impeach Hegseth, but removing him from office will be tough. And, SCOTUS ruled that a federal judge did not have the authority to halt border wall construction.
